character: Hybrid street/purpose-built circuit designed by Hermann Tilke next to the Mỹ Đình National Stadium — built for a Vietnamese Grand Prix that was never held. Mixes a temporary street section with technical, high-speed esses and a long straight into a slow hairpin.
sources: https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/revealed-new-vietnam-circuit-layout-after-extra-corner-added.4iLrvepmebiNySei26Ijx0 ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hanoi_Circuit Circuit was built but its planned F1 race was never held; only Turn 11 (hairpin) and the long Turn 6-9-to-11 acceleration zone are documented — other corners use generic Turn-N labels.

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.trap: Running wide compromises the run into the following section

corners.name: Turn 6-9
corners.technique: Rhythm and smooth inputs through the direction changes, carry maximum speed
corners.trap: Over-driving any single apex disrupts the whole sequence

corners.name: Turn 11
corners.type: slow-speed hairpin at the end of a long, 1.5km acceleration zone
corners.technique: Hard braking from top speed, late apex, patient throttle on exit
corners.trap: Misjudging the braking distance after the long flat-out run
